title: Estimating Parameters of Structural Models Using Neural Networks
eligible_reason: Methodological paper on neural-network estimation (NNE) of structural model parameters, with Monte Carlo AR(1) and sequential-search examples and SMLE comparison. No DiD or event-study design.
design_notes: NNE_AR1, NNE_search and SMLE folders: monte_carlo_data.m, nne_gen.m, nne_train.m, main_mle.m.
data_files_note: No empirical data; datasets are generated by monte_carlo_data.m (curve_seq_search.csv is a lookup table for the search model).
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text and papers/ checked Nov 2); the OpenAlex abstract in data/frame/mksc.jsonl is a one-sentence summary. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
